brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed seven Palestinians and wounded 15 others in a drone strike on a crowded coffee shop in western Gaza City on Tuesday, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The attack struck a location where civilians had gathered seeking refuge, marking one of the deadliest incidents in recent weeks.

The strike is part of a broader pattern in which IOF operations have targeted civilians sheltering in public spaces across the Gaza Strip. Coffee shops, markets, and other gathering places have come under repeated attack as Palestinians seek refuge from the conflict, the rights organization stated.
dek: On Tuesday, Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed seven Palestinians and injured 15 others in a drone strike on a coffee shop crowded with civilians in western Gaza City, in one of the deadliest attacks in recent weeks. The attack reflects the IOF’s ongoing targeting of civilians in places where they have sought refuge and gathered,.
title: Israeli drone strike kills seven in Gaza City coffee shop
